# pickaxe on stone: one point, the trigger sees the item before the damage is applied

ADV A items:durability/costs_one c
ADV A items:durability/iron_pickaxe c
ADV A items:inventory/any c

ADV A minecraft:recipes/misc/iron_nugget_from_blasting has_iron_pickaxe
ADV A minecraft:recipes/misc/iron_nugget_from_smelting has_iron_pickaxe
ADV A minecraft:story/iron_tools iron_pickaxe
I A 0 minecraft:iron_pickaxe*1/dmg=1{minecraft:damage:1}
